Cancelled a real native picker while an earlier grant remained retained. The cancelled request returned null; native counts remained starts1/stops0/pageGrants1, pickerCallbacks2.
Confirmed Open after selecting the same external file. New successful native acquisition replaced and stopped the earlier grant: starts2/stops1/completedStops1/pageGrants1.
Production window.novalist.releasePickedFile acknowledged release, leaving starts2/stops2/completedStops2/pageGrants0. This is service-release evidence, not import-dialog close UI acceptance.

Held a genuine DidPickDocumentAtUrls callback before production completion; disposed backend; tapped actual native Editing paused/Reload. Old-page disposal stopped its acquired grant (3/3); new page acquired its own (4/3). Releasing old callback resumed once and did not stop the new page grant.

Associated WebContent process termination caused host process exit via the MAUI async-void evaluator route. XCTest activation relaunched the host, resetting static counters; that reset is not evidence of native grant cleanup. Superseded by the fixed repeat.

With direct WKWebView production evaluator, initial native grant1/0 remained held while a genuine picker callback was delayed. Associated WebContent PID75238 was killed; host PID75234 survived. XCTest tapped the actual native Reload alert; old page disposed to1/1. New page acquired same external file (2/1). Old picker completion resumed once without altering new-page grant (2/1, pageGrants1). Explicit cleanup ended2/2/completed2/pageGrants0.

A real folder picker acquired the external fixture Documents directory; production endProjectAccess stopped it. Fixed-process counts3/3. This preliminary selection was not the intended exact parent and is excluded from relocation proof.

Native Files picker navigated by folder icon into MovedParent, verified SiblingA/SiblingB and selected the exact parent. Acquisition4/3, then release4/4. Fixture app used NSFileCoordinator plus FileManager.moveItem to move it to FixtureParent. Production resolveStoredProjectPath resolved BOTH old sibling paths to the new parent; each actual native start was released, ending6/6/completed6/retainedFolders0/pageGrants0. These are two synthetic directories, not full Novalist projects.
Production explicit release verified, but a selected manuscript was not closed through the actual Import Manuscript dialog. No import-dialog cleanup claim.
Actual native parent move and both directory bookmarks passed; complete Novalist sibling projects, recents and project identity were not exercised in this M02 fixture.
This work used an iPhone17Pro iOS27 simulator; it provides no physical-device acceptance.

counter_semantics: Only actual successful NSUrl.StartAccessingSecurityScopedResource returns increment successfulStarts; stopCalls increments immediately before calling native StopAccessingSecurityScopedResource, completedStops after it returns. No synthetic true returns or managed-only disposal counts.
picker_gate_semantics: Only the asynchronous real native picker completion is delayed; NSUrl comes from DidPickDocumentAtUrls. It is not manufactured. Old disposed registry rejects it before acquiring, leaving the new page grant untouched.

procedure: Build synthetic file-sharing fixture from Fixture.swift and Fixture-Info.plist, using module-name AuditFixtures, ad-hoc sign, install on dedicated simulator.
Build Novalist source revision plus combined-validation.patch with RuntimeIdentifier=iossimulator-arm64 EnableCodeSigning=true CodesignKey=-.

Use audit-control-client.py eval to start window.novalist.pickFile(title,'manuscript',{extensions:['txt']}); hold promise result in window variable. Use native XCTest to select manuscript icon/text and confirm DOCPicker.actionButton.
Record scope-state before/after each action. For old-page race, picker-hold arms exactly one real callback; confirm selection, capture state and scope before failure.

For WebKit case, read temporary private _webProcessIdentifier from state; verify OS process basename com.apple.WebKit.WebContent then kill only that PID. Native XCTest waits Editing paused and taps Reload. Confirm host process unchanged and static counters persist.

Select same external file on new page, record acquisition, picker-release old callback, record resumed1 and unchanged new page retained count. Explicit release new grant, verify starts==completedStops and zero retained.

For folder case, window.novalist.pickFolder; native XCTest taps MovedParent cell icon and waits for SiblingA/SiblingB before Open. endProjectAccess releases exact returned path. Fixture app button performs actual coordinated move to FixtureParent. Resolve old parent+SiblingA and old parent+SiblingB via production resolveStoredProjectPath, verify both new suffixes and native balance.
Preserve patches and fixture/test procedures, remove every probe source, compare cleaned sources against main production snapshot, clear disposable build outputs and rebuild before attribution.
